_meta.description: Scope exclusions and HORS PÉRIMÈTRE triggers for FIXEO serrurerie standardized prices. These conditions must cause the artisan to STOP, declare HORS PÉRIMÈTRE, and obtain explicit client approval before continuing.

global_exclusions.trigger: Artisan determines non-destructive opening is impossible
global_exclusions.description: Any technique requiring drilling, cutting, or permanent damage to lock, cylinder, or door frame. Must be explicitly disclosed to client with revised quote before proceeding.
global_exclusions.notes: Destructive opening almost always requires cylinder or mechanism replacement after. This must be quoted and approved before work begins.

global_exclusions.trigger: Door confirmed as reinforced/armoured (porte blindée) with multi-point locking
global_exclusions.description: Armoured doors require specialist tools, extended time, and have highly variable mechanisms. Cannot be reliably standardized.
global_exclusions.notes: Porte claquée blindée can be a CONDITIONAL_FIXED; porte blindée verrouillée must be DIAGNOSIS_FIRST.

global_exclusions.trigger: Any hardware replacement required (cylinder, lock body, mechanism)
global_exclusions.description: All replacement parts must be identified, specified, priced, and explicitly approved by client before installation. No silent bundling.
global_exclusions.notes: Client may choose to supply their own part. Artisan may supply only after disclosure and approval.

global_exclusions.trigger: Artisan cannot verify occupant identity or right of access
global_exclusions.description: If the person requesting opening cannot demonstrate they are the occupant/owner (CIN, bail, facture eau/electricité, or gardien attestation), artisan must NOT proceed.
global_exclusions.notes: allo-maison.ma explicitly confirms this is standard practice and professional obligation in Morocco. FIXEO must not incentivize opening without verification.

global_exclusions.description: Safe/vault opening is a specialist service with mandatory ownership verification. Not a standardizable fixed-price service.
global_exclusions.notes: Opens ONLY for documented owner. Police involvement may be required in disputed cases.

global_exclusions.trigger: Modern vehicle with electronic key, smart key, proximity key, or keyless entry
global_exclusions.description: Electronic vehicle key programming requires specialist equipment. Cannot be reliably standardized with locksmith labour alone.
global_exclusions.notes: Older vehicles (mechanical lock) can be CONDITIONAL_FIXED. Modern vehicles: specialist or manufacturer intervention.

global_exclusions.trigger: Full multipoint lock mechanism replacement required
global_exclusions.description: Multipoint lock mechanisms vary widely in brand, configuration, and price. Not safely standardizable.
global_exclusions.notes: Parts can range 500–2000 MAD. Cylinder-only replacement of a multipoint door is different and may be standardizable.

global_exclusions.description: Post-burglary intervention requires damage assessment before any work. Police PV required first for insurance. Variable scope.
global_exclusions.notes: allo-maison explicitly confirms: police PV before locksmith work to preserve insurance claim.

global_exclusions.trigger: Intervention on building common entrance, copropriété door, or shared access point
global_exclusions.description: Opening shared building access requires syndic or copropriété authorization, not individual occupant authorization alone.

global_exclusions.trigger: Electronic keypad, digicode, or connected lock malfunction or installation
global_exclusions.description: Electronic systems may require manufacturer technical support, programming equipment. Not reliably standardizable.

authorization_doctrine.title: FIXEO LOCKSMITH AUTHORIZATION DOCTRINE — RESEARCH DRAFT
authorization_doctrine.status: RESEARCH_DRAFT — for human review, not canonical
authorization_doctrine.principle: A FIXEO-registered locksmith must NEVER open a property, vehicle, or safe without reasonable verification that the requesting person has a legal right of access.

acceptable_proof: CIN / Carte Nationale d'Identité matching the address
Bail (rental contract) matching name and address
Facture eau/électricité at the address in the person's name
Attestation from on-site gardien or syndic
Presence of personal belongings visible through window/intercom
standard_residential.post_opening_verification: If documents are inside, artisan may proceed after visual confirmation (through window/intercom) and document review immediately after door opens.
standard_residential.escalation: If no proof available and no visual confirmation possible: REFUSE and advise client to contact police or landlord.

acceptable_proof: Carte grise (vehicle registration) in person's name
Proof of employment if company vehicle
Written authorization from property owner for embedded safe
safe_vault.escalation: If ownership cannot be verified: REFUSE. Police involvement may be necessary.

disputed_access.guidance: In family disputes, divorce situations, or landlord/tenant conflicts over property access: REFUSE and advise parties to resolve through legal channels. A locksmith opening a property in a disputed access situation risks participating in an unlawful act.
disputed_access.police_recommendation: Advise requesting party to obtain police accompaniment (assistance du commissariat) for legal protection of all parties.

authorization_doctrine.security_principle: FIXEO pricing must NEVER create an economic incentive for the artisan to bypass authorization checks. No bonus, no volume incentive, no minimum throughput requirement should compromise this.

services_not_in_fixeo_scope.reason: No call-out required. Client visits artisan shop. Not a FIXEO intervention.
Separate specialist trade. Not standard locksmith scope.

services_not_in_fixeo_scope.service: Menuiserie / réparation dormant / réparation encadrement porte

services_not_in_fixeo_scope.reason: Electronic access control is a separate specialist scope.
